description: Rete Ecologica Regionale - aree centrali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.regione.lazio.it. The Lazio Regional Ecological Network (REcoRdLazio) is an integral part of the Regional Plan for Protected Natural Areas (PRANP) as provided for in Article 7 of Regional Law 29/97 on “regional protected natural areas”. The dataset reports the central areas (cores). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Regional Ecological Network — central areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT, Global, Ambiente e natura. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
